labels.label: engine
labels.caption: A full-size American truck-based V8 starts and revs — used as a stand-in for the Raptor's 3.5-litre EcoBoost V6.

labels.label: shocks
labels.caption: A heavy landing thump, for the FOX long-travel suspension.

labels.label: tyres
labels.caption: Gravel, rock and stones being raked — a close stand-in for all-terrain tyres on dirt (not a drive-by recording).

labels.label: grille
labels.caption: A turbo blow-off / wastegate whoosh, for air slamming through the big Raptor grille and the EcoBoost turbos.

labels.label: headlamps
labels.caption: A light-switch click, for the quad-beam LED headlamps.

labels.label: body
labels.caption: A vehicle rushing past, for wind over the aluminium body.

labels.label: fenders
labels.caption: An air whoosh around the flared fenders.

labels.label: skid
labels.caption: A hard scrape across rough stone, for the front skid plate hitting rock.

labels.label: cab
labels.caption: A car door closing on the SuperCrew cab.

labels.label: bed
labels.caption: A metal drop / slam, for the aluminium tailgate and cargo bed.

ambient.caption: A low desert-style wind loop under the object page, once sound is enabled.

ui.caption: A short UI tick for hovering a label. Optional — hook only if it feels right, and debounce it.
